name: Carabaña (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carabaña (a red saltire on green, a tree and a fountain on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Carabaña; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Carabaña arms — red saltire on green, tree and fountain on yellow
